relationships.evidence_quote: In rodents and humans, repeated cocaine exposure significantly decreases Protein Arginine Methyltransferase-6 (PRMT6) and its associated histone mark

relationships.subject: cocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: acute cocaine treatment decreases DNMT1, DNMT3a, TET1, and TET2 transcript levels in mouse NAc

relationships.subject: sodium butyrate
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of HDAC activity using sodium butyrate increases heroin reinstatement in rats

key_findings: Review: drugs of abuse alter epigenetic modifiers (DNMTs, TETs, HDACs, PRMT6, ncRNAs) that regulate opioid receptor gene expression.
